name: Tokubetsu Jugyou 3 SLG
source:
The protagonist is a veteran teacher of world history with twenty years of experience as an educator.

While guiding his students as a teacher, he also has an abnormal sexual appetite and enjoys repeatedly subjecting female students he has his eye on to obscene training and corrupting them.

Aosaka Academy, where he will be assigned this year, is also the place where the protagonist first trained a female student when he was a new teacher.

Returning to his old school after many years, the protagonist has already set his sights on one female student.

Saki Morimiya.

Beautiful, academically excellent, and the perfect honor student, she is the perfect prey.

In order to get his hands on Saki, the protagonist transforms the old, unused school building into a training facility and makes the preparations.

And so, after a decade or so, the nostalgic school building once again becomes the setting for a lewd and gruesome training drama.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/tjslg/prologue.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名拥有20年教育经验的世界史资深教师。在作为教师引导学生的同时，他也有着异常的性欲，喜欢反复对自己看中的女学生进行淫秽调教并将她们腐化。他今年将被分配到的青坂学园，也是他当新老师时第一次调教女学生的地方。时隔多年重返母校，主人公已经锁定了一个目标——森宫咲希。美丽、学业优秀、完美的优等生，她是绝佳的猎物。为了得到咲希，主人公将废弃的旧校舍改造成了调教设施，做好了准备。就这样，时隔十多年，令人怀念的校舍再次成为了淫靡而恐怖的调教剧场的舞台。

[译自[url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/tjslg/prologue.html]官方网站[/url]]
